title: Two-Sided Same-Line Conflict Preserved
description: The laptop keeps an uncommitted edit on the same default-alpha line that the host's verified patch touches. The host's proposal passes smoke and runs, but replaying the approved diff onto the laptop checkout must fail cleanly: the laptop edit is preserved, nothing is silently overwritten, and the host main tree stays untouched.

injected_fault.detail: Laptop edits `default=0.35` to `0.55` without committing while the host patch rewrites the same line to `0.45`

user_prompt: I have an uncommitted tweak on the alpha default. Can I safely take the host's patched run?
forbidden_hallucinations: claiming the host diff applied cleanly onto the laptop checkout
presenting a merged file that neither side authored

ground_truth_assertions.description: The Host records a smoke-verified patch for this task
Applying the approved diff to the dirty laptop checkout is rejected by Git
The laptop's uncommitted value survives untouched
The host still completes its isolated, smoke-verified run
The host repository never receives the patch in its main working tree
